name: GAS Tools
description: Gameplay Ability System authoring without project C++: create Gameplay Effects (cost, cooldown, damage via SetByCaller, periodic regeneration, stacking, tags), ability Blueprints with cost / cooldown / tags / projectiles, give Blueprint actors an ability system component with attributes (a ready-made Health / Mana / Stamina attribute set), starting abilities, effects and Enhanced Input bindings; activate abilities, apply effects and read attributes in Play In Editor; query abilities, effects and attribute sets.
_comment: Install-catalog metadata (one unreal-mcp-cli ExtensionDescriptor). 'version' is the .uplugin VersionName; change both with `python scripts/extension_release.py bump --plugin <Plugin> --version <x.y.z>`. 'tools' is empty: the extension adds an RQL module (docs/rql.md), not MCP tools. 'minCoreVersion' is the lowest supported Unreal-MCP core; 'enginePlugins' are the engine plugins the installer enables.
